comparison.objective: Position a ball retainer and roll a slide member between its rollers until seated; candidate replaces a harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-member alignment, constrained insertion, and rolling retainer engagement versus connector latch manipulation and mating.
comparison.success_condition: PR measures riding pose, retainer position, rolling behavior, misses, and final seating; candidate supplies no insertion geometry or thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both include insertion, but roller-guided slide assembly tests a meaningfully different contact mechanism.
